description: Export sketch data to a file

keywords.name: set
keywords.description: Specify a sketch set to export. If set name is not specified, currently active or last active sketch set is used.

keywords.name: format
keywords.description: Specify the output file format. Supported formats are dxf , geo , and grd .

keywords.name: filename
keywords.description: Specify the path and name of the output file.

keywords.name: edge
keywords.description: Specify whether to export edges. Default is true . If set to false , edges will not be exported.

keywords.name: mesh
keywords.description: Specify whether to export mesh faces. Default is true . If set to false , mesh faces will not be exported.

keywords.name: three
keywords.description: Specify whether to export the mesh in 3D.

7.0: Not in the 7.0 manual. FLAC3D 7.0 writes out.dxf in the working directory and takes no filename or format.
9.0: format takes a bare word: format dxf works, format 'dxf' is rejected.
